class.name: SteamItemDefinition
class.brief_description: One published item definition copied from the Steam catalog.
class.description: [method SteamInventory.definitions] and [method SteamInventory.definition] copy the app's published definitions. The read-only dictionary contains Steam's available custom properties. The display name or type is empty if the corresponding property is absent.

method.name: get_definition_id
method.description: Returns the published numeric item definition ID.

method.name: get_display_name
method.description: Returns steam's localized display name for this item.

method.name: get_type
method.description: Returns the item type configured in the Steam definition.

method.name: get_properties
method.description: Returns the typed read-only dictionary of published properties.

members.member: The published numeric item definition ID.
Steam's localized display name for this item.
The item type configured in the Steam definition.
